mainEntity.name: How does AI SEO impact my Google search rankings?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI SEO directly impacts Google search rankings by helping your content align with Google's evolving algorithms, which increasingly use AI to understand context, intent, and natural language. When your content is optimized based on deep customer query research, it becomes more relevant and valuable to users. This relevance is a key ranking factor, leading to improved visibility in search results, featured snippets, and other AI-driven search experiences. Essentially, it helps your content be 'understood' better by Google's AI.
acceptedAnswer.description: AI SEO improves Google rankings by aligning content with AI-driven algorithms that prioritize context, intent, and natural language, making your content more relevant and visible.
